### Potential Risks of Mixing

- **Worsened side effects:** Both fluconazole and alcohol can cause headaches, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and dizziness. Drinking can make these symptoms more likely or more severe.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjn-mKJYgjHAAPwSGAIB6cKYt8qyfAw-yASfIpK-u6EnAEM6OThZp_sWTa-Gr_tii360Ry-RTIvsZVZ0fvSSSihf9g1UUIq12Bu1YxZuMVjSJ-rnPRi4DFe7J-i6zKEax)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16m30Tq6GHxARjqWckEY7cy7kXgolf8MFQc0SqxVKkbFk9H-NBw_ImKAiyTg2HEJNUOsi2azc2MJg3VFdDkVQEPtVQ1sHXaMpHbGy5JzIVqy5vmWj9tdiyJcezvpYUXP9MmivTHp5ziAoG7zeY0hdtWx-i-GeVKiCELAEQnu)
- **Liver strain:** Both substances are processed by the liver. Heavy or frequent drinking increases the risk of liver problems, which fluconazole can rarely cause on its own.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16m30Tq6GHxARjqWckEY7cy7kXgolf8MFQc0SqxVKkbFk9H-NBw_ImKAiyTg2HEJNUOsi2azc2MJg3VFdDkVQEPtVQ1sHXaMpHbGy5JzIVqy5vmWj9tdiyJcezvpYUXP9MmivTHp5ziAoG7zeY0hdtWx-i-GeVKiCELAEQnu)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF10wrcJB40tDgAwNC13t-oyoO3wTm_556eABX4ewVDP7vh9vQUZ6Fn1TwZ9A-qaMcYfEgbKFknNKW_SgTUlRaPQR8ATjSv6iXOEoMnPLEqQRLU9MaHedKzwBQ3jLn5cTNss6JmK1PhKVkE1ikPGfVVVpVLLtqFb08z4wHX0b5CNlHdah0xYxoqlSe6a4vt8ypCA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjn-mKJYgjHAAPwSGAIB6cKYt8qyfAw-yASfIpK-u6EnAEM6OThZp_sWTa-Gr_tii360Ry-RTIvsZVZ0fvSSSihf9g1UUIq12Bu1YxZuMVjSJ-rnPRi4DFe7J-i6zKEax)
- **Slower recovery:** Alcohol can weaken your immune response, potentially making it harder for your body to clear an infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF10wrcJB40tDgAwNC13t-oyoO3wTm_556eABX4ewVDP7vh9vQUZ6Fn1TwZ9A-qaMcYfEgbKFknNKW_SgTUlRaPQR8ATjSv6iXOEoMnPLEqQRLU9MaHedKzwBQ3jLn5cTNss6JmK1PhKVkE1ikPGfVVVpVLLtqFb08z4wHX0b5CNlHdah0xYxoqlSe6a4vt8ypCA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)

### How Long to Wait

- **Single dose vs. multi-day course:** A single 150 mg dose is generally lower risk than a multi-day or high-dose regimen, especially if you have a healthy liver. For multi-day courses, waiting until you finish treatment is safer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1_GM4LzSXwALXE7QwIk6j5mvDDLfDRvtMCEp_9hIXDzsejfZ3EiQnKk63-N3GYylns-12FZL4KRTvD2uUsc4lKePhNNgt6tX2T9avoWc3u6zo73GsL7X0-_GnQdIk-UqHdfAFDtO8cmwUtGeQRmmpso4WhEy8DH91Uh4raHv1_saEqhJBYUZPFW2_a_00EBmEc3AuLRd)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF10wrcJB40tDgAwNC13t-oyoO3wTm_556eABX4ewVDP7vh9vQUZ6Fn1TwZ9A-qaMcYfEgbKFknNKW_SgTUlRaPQR8ATjSv6iXOEoMnPLEqQRLU9MaHedKzwBQ3jLn5cTNss6JmK1PhKVkE1ikPGfVVVpVLLtqFb08z4wHX0b5CNlHdah0xYxoqlSe6a4vt8ypCA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjn-mKJYgjHAAPwSGAIB6cKYt8qyfAw-yASfIpK-u6EnAEM6OThZp_sWTa-Gr_tii360Ry-RTIvsZVZ0fvSSSihf9g1UUIq12Bu1YxZuMVjSJ-rnPRi4DFe7J-i6zKEax)

### What Fluconazole Treats and How It Works

- **Uses:** It treats fungal and yeast (*Candida* ) infections, such as vaginal yeast infections, oral thrush, and more serious systemic infections.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXjn-mKJYgjHAAPwSGAIB6cKYt8qyfAw-yASfIpK-u6EnAEM6OThZp_sWTa-Gr_tii360Ry-RTIvsZVZ0fvSSSihf9g1UUIq12Bu1YxZuMVjSJ-rnPRi4DFe7J-i6zKEax)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXkCZHaSbOZctWU-8lFHYrAL5BTcyi_pd1VCdoppUPKr8JSCsgV5KVmZqAKJik6CWyMWnDS5ifgJoGBkx7JRfIsfxw-a1ws7ouIhOlulBXYilYHIoH1nLv18c_j7v6DpKjBrhC9Kfe)
- **How it works:** It blocks an enzyme fungi need to build their cell membranes, stopping fungal growth so your body can clear the infection.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEBxCJF1_GM4LzSXwALXE7QwIk6j5mvDDLfDRvtMCEp_9hIXDzsejfZ3EiQnKk63-N3GYylns-12FZL4KRTvD2uUsc4lKePhNNgt6tX2T9avoWc3u6zo73GsL7X0-_GnQdIk-UqHdfAFDtO8cmwUtGeQRmmpso4WhEy8DH91Uh4raHv1_saEqhJBYUZPFW2_a_00EBmEc3AuLRd)

For more details on side effects and timing, see [SingleCare](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c) or general guidance from the [NHS](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXIFavjBdpEvLnRVSAk7kIzI6SS4zS4PE1saRHxIEkYBLwlYYjysDDE7dYRMi0SRFXSvRkpWN-Smus6jsIuSw52qKgZwnF3od6LUUQ_3G11-RUNxtDun4qcC3Ht_EWGPM) . If you have liver issues or take other medications, check with a doctor or pharmacist first.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZAHEIkXXIFavjBdpEvLnRVSAk7kIzI6SS4zS4PE1saRHxIEkYBLwlYYjysDDE7dYRMi0SRFXSvRkpWN-Smus6jsIuSw52qKgZwnF3od6LUUQ_3G11-RUNxtDun4qcC3Ht_EWGPM)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXuTmal2guUGqyWBsbPhhDkNv7Sxzt15Oe6wRumWyUKeym_kqiUbrwZdmAza5NdefbUM2x5Jf6fC91tYr3PvkxKleIkj-OEuXfvKD2B9ONpK4WyhmWpH0NZ35IM1Ow5QNiLrlLOw5brlTf-ZCs02c)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF16m30Tq6GHxARjqWckEY7cy7kXgolf8MFQc0SqxVKkbFk9H-NBw_ImKAiyTg2HEJNUOsi2azc2MJg3VFdDkVQEPtVQ1sHXaMpHbGy5JzIVqy5vmWj9tdiyJcezvpYUXP9MmivTHp5ziAoG7zeY0hdtWx-i-GeVKiCELAEQnu)Are you asking about a **single dose** or a **multi-day course** , and do you have any **liver conditions** or **other medications** to consider?
